definitions.explanation: The cover placed on top of a pot or saucepan during cooking. A basic kitchen item.

definitions.gloss: the kanji radical {亠|なべぶた} (lid radical)
definitions.explanation: In kanji studies, the name for the radical {亠|なべぶた}, which appears at the top of characters like {京|きょう}, {高|こう}, and {亭|てい}.

examples.japanese: {鍋蓋|なべぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take off the pot lid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鍋蓋|なべぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{弱火|よわび}→弱火：08168_yowabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When simmering, put the lid on and turn it to low heat.

examples.japanese: {鍋蓋|なべぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ずらして→ずらす：20836_zurasu⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{吹|ふ}きこぼれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}げる→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: If you offset the pot lid slightly, you can prevent boiling over.

examples.japanese: 「{京|きょう}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鍋蓋|なべぶた}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{部首|ぶしゅ}→部首：00023_bushu⟧だ。
examples.english: The top part of '京' is a radical called nabebuta.

examples.japanese: {鍋蓋|なべぶた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧」や「{亭|てい}」⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The nabebuta radical is also used in '高' and '亭.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{部首|ぶしゅ}→部首：00023_bushu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧とき、{鍋蓋|なべぶた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二画|にかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}される→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧。
examples.english: When looking up kanji by radical, nabebuta is classified under two strokes.

notes:
Has two distinct uses: as a common kitchen term and as the name of a kanji radical. The radical sense comes from the shape of {亠|なべぶた} resembling a pot lid.

FORMS:
⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (pot) + {蓋|ぶた} (lid). The ⟦{蓋|ふた}→蓋：03896_futa⟧ becomes ぶた through rendaku (sequential voicing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (COOKING):
- {鍋蓋|なべぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put on the pot lid
- {鍋蓋|なべぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove the pot lid
- {鍋蓋|なべぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ずらす→ずらす：20836_zurasu⟧: to shift the lid slightly
- ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鍋蓋|なべぶた}: glass pot lid

RELATED COOKING TERMS:
- ⟦{落|お}とし{蓋|ぶた}→落とし蓋：08321_otoshibuta⟧: drop lid — a smaller lid placed directly on food while simmering
- ⟦{蓋|ふた}→蓋：03896_futa⟧: lid (general term)
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: pot, pan
